source: Table C-18, p.C-87; Table C-24, p.C-95; C.4.13, pp.C-54 to C-56; C.4.10, pp.C-43 to C-45
description: In MANAGEMENT(CONNECTED) an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY and a RESET/WIN-RESYNC are each answered with WARNING reason 3, after the MANAGEMENT acknowledgement (issue M0LTE/M0LTE.S5066#45).
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, our accept goes out at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 16-bit family (B-0213, B-0142) and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs (B-0215). D_CONNECTION_MADE starts the expedited ARQ machine afresh as well (C-0755). The peer is recorded Ed4, so spare room in a last block takes a PADDING D_PDU when it fits (C-0367, C-1154). At 61000 the peer's burst holds a MANAGEMENT (type 6) D_PDU with VALID MESSAGE set and frame ID 0, then an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY (type 5, RX LWE 0, no bitmap), then a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) with RESET TX WIN RQST set, NEW RECEIVE LWE 0 and RESET FRAME ID 0 (EOT 20 on all three). The type 6 moves IDLE(CONNECTED) to MANAGEMENT(CONNECTED) (C-0664) and owes an acknowledgement (C-0296). In MANAGEMENT(CONNECTED) the type 5 draws WARNING reason 3, invalid D_PDU for the current state (C-0723), and so does the type 12, whose request is not acted on (C-0721); each is reported to the CAS with D_WARNING_TRANSMITTED, which shows in no output (C-0733). At 83000 the MANAGEMENT acknowledgement goes first (ACK set, frame ID 0; 13 bytes, EOT 20), then the two WARNINGs, oldest first (C-1041): received type 5 reason 3 (12 bytes, starting in block 0, EOT 20) and received type 12 reason 3 (12 bytes, starting in block 1, EOT 10). 37 bytes in 2 blocks; the 13 left take one PADDING (EOT 10). The transmission ends at 93350; nothing waits for an answer. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20 for 1, 2 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so an EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY is 18 bytes plus its segment, an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY 12 bytes plus its bitmap, a MANAGEMENT D_PDU with no extended bytes 13, a WARNING 12, a PADDING 11, a DATA-ONLY 19 bytes plus its segment and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
